name: animated-faq
title: Animated FAQ
description: Accessible FAQ accordion with smooth or elastic Motion animations, staggered answers and fills

changelog.summary: Rebuilt on Motion with the Animated Accordion features: open on hover, elastic springs, delayed and staggered answers, muted or accent fill and a plus/minus icon. Replaces gsap with motion.
Updated accordion behavior and documented reduced-motion support.

props.name: allowMultiple
props.description: Lets more than one FAQ answer stay open at once.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Answers open while a mouse rests on them and close when it leaves. Touch still uses taps.

props.name: fill
props.description: A background that grows down from the top while an item is open.

props.name: elastic
props.description: Springs instead of easing for the panel, fill, line and content.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the springs overshoot. Needs Elastic.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the answer starts to appear.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between each part of the answer appearing.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Shows or hides the FAQ trigger icon.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Side where the trigger icon is rendered.

props.name: iconMode
props.description: Icon animation: a chevron that turns down or right, or a plus that turns into a minus.
